name: parsinegar.export
description: Parsinegar export: standalone themed HTML documents and multi-document Markdown zip archives over Persian Markdown (Parsneshan)

provides.name: parsinegar.export.service
provides.description: Exports Markdown documents as standalone themed RTL HTML files and as Markdown zip archives.

methods.name: exportHtml
methods.description: Renders Markdown with Persian extensions and assembles a full standalone document.

methods.name: exportZip
methods.description: Packs Markdown documents (with folder paths) into one zip archive of .md files.

params.name: documents
params.type: Array of { markdown: string, title: string (optional), path: string (optional folder path, '' for root) }
